description: Source code implementing X509 auxiliary data handling functions for OpenSSL, including encoding, setting, getting, and clearing trust and reject objects, as well as alias and key ID management.

methods.name: aux_get
methods.description: Retrieves or creates auxiliary data for an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_alias_set1
methods.description: Sets the alias string for an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_keyid_set1
methods.description: Sets the key ID for an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_alias_get0
methods.description: Retrieves the alias string from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_keyid_get0
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_add1_trust_object
methods.description: Adds a trust object to an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_add1_reject_object
methods.description: Adds a reject object to an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_trust_clear
methods.description: Clears trust objects from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_reject_clear
methods.description: Clears reject objects from an X509 certificate.
